levers.name: CCL options
levers.reason: per-call options of the 128 unit-major reduce-scatters and the 129 norm gathers a pass that cannot change a bit (the ring's chunk parity is a function of the tile index, not of links, workers, sync cadence or buffer depth; the gather copies): this value is the CANDIDATE before the sweep, one worker per direction (no fabric mux core) and one chunk per semaphore sync on both ops; after the sweep (references/fusion-jobs-wp5, P1-P4) set it to the probe's promote string and nothing else changes

profiles.name: ccl-served
profiles.reason: the A/A control of the plumbing: the unit-major reduce-scatter hook and the DistributedNorm gather shim engaged with an EMPTY set, so every call carries the values the model passes today; its timed pair is the control-to-control floor of the plumbing and it must be byte-identical to the production profile

profiles.name: ccl-served-audit
profiles.reason: the plumbing control audited: every audited call is compared with itself on the device (a harness that cannot see a difference reads exact=True here, so a mismatch in the sets' audits is a finding about the set, not about the audit)

image_files.reason: the named sets, the strict flags, the plan of a block forward (imported by the overlaid tile_collective_tp.py)
the shim around DistributedNorm.forward's gather, pinned by the source sha256 (imported by the overlaid tile_collective_tp.py)
the stricter smoke rule of the lever (counts, canonical set name, one audit line per op and block owner)

notes: F-C1. No tp_addresses row: tile_collective_tp.install() (already called by tp_addresses.install) also binds the gather shim when QWEN_FAST_CCL_OPTIONS is set and puts it back through the same list. The probe launch needs scripts/ci/fusion-wp/WP5-fabric-probe.patch (FABRIC_PROBES in c2_serving_job.py and the case in qwen-c2-serving.yml; test_ccl_options_jobs holds that it applies). The sweep, hang 5/5 and plumbing templates are scripts/ci/references/fusion-jobs-wp5 (a sibling folder: test_tp4_fusion_jobs reads every entry of fusion-jobs as a file, so a subfolder there breaks it), generated by optimisation/ttnn-op/ccl_sweep/make_pack.py. THE ORDER: P0, P1 (and P2-P4), read the promote strings, set the lever's value to the winner (one line here), regenerate with make_fusion_profiles.py --write, then the generated CCLA audit, the WP5 hang runs CCLH1-CCLH5 and the generated ABAB. ccl-served is not a lever of the generated pack: its two profiles are for the WP5 plumbing job CCLS.
